description: The image presents two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss Kappa values across different ambiguity metrics. In both charts, the vertical value axis is labeled "Fleiss Kappa" and features a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 at regular intervals of 0.2. The left chart evaluates "Ambiguity Std" on its horizontal category axis, which includes the numerically ordered categories "0.0", "0.47", "0.82", and "0.94". This chart contains four bars rendered in varying shades of blue, with exact values annotated above each bar: the tallest bar corresponds to category "0.0" with a value of 0.88 (dark blue), followed by "0.47" at 0.46 (medium blue), "0.94" at 0.24 (medium-light blue), and the shortest bar for "0.82" at 0.03 (light blue). The right chart evaluates "Max Ambiguity" on its horizontal category axis, displaying the numerically ordered categories "1", "2", and "3". This chart contains three bars, also colored in varying shades of blue and annotated with exact values above them, which appear in descending order of height: the tallest bar is for category "1" at 0.89 (dark blue), followed by "2" at 0.46 (medium blue), and the shortest bar is for "3" at 0.23 (light blue). Neither chart contains grouped or stacked bars, and visual emphasis is provided through the numerical annotations atop every bar.
